$description: Platform-neutral normalization of design-tokens.json's elevation layer. Elevation is resolved through the same semantic surface/elevation tokens in both themes — components never branch on theme to decide shadow strength; the token value already differs per theme.

0.usage: flat, resting elements using border only

darkModeNote: Dark surfaces prefer a lighter surface tone (surface.elevated) over heavier shadow. Shadow color stays black; opacity reduces ~30% relative to light values since dark backgrounds already read as elevated via tone.

platformMapping.android: Modifier.shadow(elevation = MentoraTheme.elevation.N), paired with Surface(tonalElevation=) in dark theme
